data: Which model has a plot with the lowest maximum value marked on its x axis

The question asks which model has a plot with the lowest maximum value marked on its x-axis. From the caption, we know that the first row of the figure shows the learned representations from models with the multimodal task only, while the second row shows the learned representations from multi-task models. The two subgraphs in the same column contrast each other.

Looking at the x-axis values for all six graphs:

1. LF-DNN: The x-axis ranges from -30 to 40.
2. TFN: The x-axis ranges from -30 to 40.
3. LMF: The x-axis ranges from -20 to 30.
4. MLE-DNN: The x-axis ranges from -40 to 40.
5. MTEN: The x-axis ranges from -40 to 40.
6. MLMF: The x-axis ranges from -40 to 30.

Among these, the smallest range is for LMF, which goes from -20 to 30. Therefore, the model with the lowest maximum value marked on its x-axis is LMF.
